Body.Content:
Business value

When an employee leaves, HR, managers, IT, facilities and payroll all have work to do, but the termination hasn't been connected to the request that starts the exit or the work that follows. Manual coordination can leave access open, property unreturned and final pay incomplete. This feature connects the termination to a governed, visible exit journey, so HR runs consistent exits with less follow-up.

Capability details

Separation requests: Employees resign and managers request separations in self service, with approval and policies per company and worker type.

Safer termination: Notice details, configurable checks, bulk termination and direct report moves.

Rule-based checklists: Templates apply automatically when conditions match, with due-date anchors and predecessors.

Property and access: Return tasks for loaned items such as laptops and badges; scheduled Dynamics 365 access deactivation.

Task evidence: Attachments, exit questionnaires, generated or signed documents, verification and task history.

Reminders, business events and legal hold for overdue tasks and connected systems.

Exit workspaces: Offboarding control tower for HR, Exiting workers for managers and My exit for leavers.

Final settlement worksheet: Open expenses, advances, timesheets, leave and unreturned property for payroll.

Rehire guard: Warns or blocks rehiring based on eligibility, with an approved override.

Roles and integration: Coordinator roles, a segregation-of-duties rule and public data entities.

Enablement

Turn on the 12 offboarding features in Feature management, then configure Human resources shared parameters, separation policies, checklist rules, coordinator roles and batch jobs. Turning a feature off keeps existing data.

GA date: June CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
